title: Scalar localization as an ordinary module-sheaf colimit
statement: On a small ringed site, let R be a sheaf of commutative A-algebras and t in A, with the canonical coefficient actions of [def-weil-pbc-scalar-localization-coefficient-actions]. Let M be an R-module sheaf and N its actual change of rings to the sheafified localization R[1/t] of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization]. Let U be actual restriction of scalars and eta:M → U(N) the sectionwise normalized unit x ↦ 1 tensor x. Then the repeated-t sequence of M has a colimit c and an isomorphism beta:c.pt ≅ U(N), with c_n beta = eta U((invSelf t)^n). No exactness, complex, or derived-category hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Take the fraction colimit of the regular module, then tensor its cocone on the right with M. Tensor-Hom adjunction and symmetry show that this functor preserves the colimit. Its regular tensor unitor identifies the repeated source with M, and the extension-tensor comparison and localized-ring module comparison identify the apex with restricted scalar extension.

The pure-tensor formulas identify the zeroth leg with the specified unit, and identify the transported transition with multiplication by t. On the apex multiplication by t is invertible, with inverse given by restricted multiplication by invSelf(t). Induction cancels this invertible scalar in the cocone equation and identifies every leg with the unit followed by the nth inverse power. Transport the preserved colimit along the constant source isomorphism.

theorem scalarLocalization_moduleColimit
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (a : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (R.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (t : A)
    (M : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
    (N : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
      (ringedLocalizationRing R (a t))))
    (hN : N = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings (ringedLocalizationRingUnit R (a t)) M)
    (U : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
        (ringedLocalizationRing R (a t))) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
    (hU : U = SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
        (ringedLocalizationRingUnit R (a t))))
    (η : M ⟶ U.obj N)
    (hη : scalarLocalizationTelescopeUnitSections (ringedLocalizationRingUnit R (a t))
      M N hN (η ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun T ↦ T.obj N) hU))) :
    (fun [_source : Linear A (ringedSiteModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
      [_target : Linear (Localization.Away t) (ringedSiteModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
          (ringedLocalizationRing R (a t))))] ↦
      ∃ c : Cocone (Functor.ofSequence (X := fun _n : ℕ ↦ M) (fun _n ↦ t • 𝟙 M)),
        Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧ ∃ β : c.pt ≅ U.obj N,
          ∀ n : ℕ, c.ι.app n ≫ β.hom = η ≫ U.map
            (((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf t : Localization.Away t) ^ n) • 𝟙 N))
      (_source := scalarLocalizationCoefficientLinear A R a)
      (_target := scalarLocalizationCoefficientLinear (Localization.Away t)
        (ringedLocalizationRing R (a t)) (scalarLocalizationCoefficientMap A R a t))
